entries.description: A smoother player, easier Connect controls, and recent app updates in Stream.

changelog.title: New
items: Tap the LuvLyrics logo in Stream to read the four latest updates.

changelog.title: Improved
items: Player animations now follow your phone's reduced-motion setting.
Connect controls now live in one easy-to-find panel.

entries.description: Find lyrics for more songs and enjoy easier controls across the app.

changelog.title: New
items: Find lyrics for more versions of the same song.

changelog.title: Improved
items: The small player and import controls are easier to use.
Text and animations work more naturally across the app.

entries.description: Last.fm keeps better track of the songs you listen to.

changelog.title: Improved
items: Last.fm now keeps your listening history more reliably.

entries.description: Downloaded songs are easier to find.

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Downloaded songs now use their song title as the file name.
